description: Traffic Calming is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Location points of various traffic calming infrastructure throughout Bloomington, Indiana. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are gis, transportation, traffic calming, traffic, speed bumps. The table has 8 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
